summary: Source code is well-typed TypeScript with clear error handling and modular design. Workflow uses proper GitHub Actions patterns (least-privilege perms, checkout@v4, GITHUB_OUTPUT integration). Issues: (1) Bun install (lines 16–19) lacks error handling—should use `set -euo pipefail` or `oven-sh/setup-bun` action; curl failure doesn't stop execution. (2) Workflow assumes label-config.json and changed-files.txt exist but provides no mechanism to create/validate them; would fail without these files. (3) No actionlint validation shown (task requires it). (4) Glob regex construction is complex but well-encapsulated. Modular structure (config, glob, label-assigner, render, cli) is maintainable; each module has clear responsibility. Minor: Bun install could pin version for reproducibility.
